issues.description: The problem statement claims that the type `fix_t` is an alias for `float` (problem_statement.md line 25). However, both the template and solution code treat `fix_t` as a fixed-point integer type (typedefs and FIX_LEN/FIX_FRAC macros in math_fix.h / math_fix.c). This is a direct type/semantic contradiction: students reading the problem will expect to use floats for `fix_t`, but the provided code, tests and assembly stubs all expect fixed-point integer semantics and conversion helpers (fix_float2fix / fix_fix2float). This mismatch will confuse students about the intended numeric representation and prevent correct implementation of the assembly routines (which operate on integer fixed-point values).
issues.suggested_fix: Fix the problem statement to reflect the actual numeric type used in the code: state that `fix_t` is a fixed-point integer type (whose underlying integer width is controlled by FIX_LEN and whose fractional bits are FIX_FRAC) and that helper functions (fix_float2fix, fix_fix2float, etc.) convert between float and the fixed-point representation. Example wording: "Für die Berechnungen wird der Typ `fix_t` verwendet. `fix_t` ist ein ganzzahliger Festkomma-Typ (abhängig von FIX_LEN/FIX_FRAC), nicht ein `float`. Verwenden Sie die bereitgestellten Hilfsfunktionen zur Umwandlung zwischen float und fix_t." This preserves the educational intent and avoids student confusion.

issues.description: The problem statement declares that the type `fix_t` is an alias for `float` (problem_statement.md), but the template and solution code define `fix_t` as an integer fixed-point type (typedef int long long / controlled by FIX_LEN and FIX_FRAC in math_fix.h / math_fix.c). This is a direct naming/meaning mismatch for the same identifier `fix_t` across artifacts and will confuse students about whether they should treat `fix_t` values as floats or as fixed-point integers (affecting conversions, expected function signatures, and arithmetic).
issues.suggested_fix: Align the wording and type definitions. Preferred fix: correct the problem statement to say that `fix_t` is a fixed-point integer type (e.g. typedef int64_t when FIX_LEN==8) with FIX_FRAC fractional bits, and that helper conversions fix_float2fix / fix_fix2float must be used. Example replacement sentence: "Für die Berechnungen wird der Typ `fix_t` verwendet; dies ist ein ganzzahliger Fixed‑Point‑Typ (nicht float) — die Genauigkeit wird durch FIX_FRAC bestimmt. Verwenden Sie fix_float2fix und fix_fix2float zur Konversion." Alternatively (if the original intent was floats) change the code typedefs so `fix_t` is an alias for float — but pick one consistent definition across problem, template, and solution.
